title_short: Bruce Leuchter · Waiting on Variant Testing
length: about 60 s (the four brief bites run 55 s)
headline: The drug company CEO answers the question families ask most: my child's variant is still being tested, why so long, and who is working on it?
story: Families want their child's variant characterized. Bruce says the company knows, and needs it too: it is how a child can join the study.
Their goal is to get children into the study as fast as they can, with as many collaborators as they can.
It is not one company's job. Investigators, scientists and the whole community want the right patient in the study.

Don't publish: GRIN Therapeutics approves first.
